short_description: Infarm - Indoor Urban Farming GmbH is a Berlin-headquartered German vertical-farming and controlled-environment agriculture company founded in 2013 by Erez Galonska, Guy Galonska and Osnat Michaeli that deploys modular in-store and warehouse-scale growing units for leafy greens, herbs and produce. In December 2021 Infarm closed a Series D funding round that took its post-money valuation above one billion US dollars, giving it European unicorn status.
